customManagers.description: The `github-release-attachments` datasource computes the checksum of the yq_linux_amd64 release asset. The GitHub tag carries a leading `v`; the option default does not. `currentValueTemplate` adds it back for the lookup, and the `replace` helper strips it again on write.

packageRules.description: A yanked yq release should not land the same day it ships.
